notes.title: Minor Update 1.1 - March 4, 2024
notes.notes:
Made a couple of minor updates based on feedback from players:


 Changed the spectate system: If you die early in an online match, you will automatically start spectating the nearest player rather than having your viewpoint stuck.
 Minor UI Tweaks: Made some minor tweaks to the "Map Transition" UI, aimed at making the information clearer.
 Installation Bug Fix for Linux Users: Fixed unnecessarily large installation size for native Linux users.

Have fun and keep blastin'!
